_comment: Vetted fallback miners per PR Guard check, best first. Every check is first asked through Telegraph's routing (a canonical intent + params ask; see src/checks.js); a miner here is called directly only when the routed answer is unusable, and the next one only if that call fails. Entries: minerId, name, intent, method, endpoint, payload ({{var}} placeholders), normalizer (src/normalize.js), optional ecosystems filter, optional enabled:false. A routed answer from a miner listed here is read with its normalizer.

deps.name: PR Guard Sentinel
deps._note: Our own miner (disclosed); rates PyPI/Go/crates.io, which deps.dev Package Review (npm-only) can't.

deps.name: Secrev Depsdev
deps._note: Advisory ids only, unrated: last resort, so its findings give CAUTION, never BLOCK.

diff.name: Telegraph Verity
diff._note: Independent operator. Takes the old intent name inside its payload (verified Nov 2 and Nov 13). Used for diff chunks over the 2,000-character canonical limit, or when the routed review is unusable.

diff.name: PR Guard Sentinel
diff._note: Our own rule-based miner (disclosed), used only if Verity fails.
